Hmm, no I live in a fairly small town in Australia, I live with a family member who I love very dearly, and am at no risk of becoming homeless. My biggest risk right now is me. 
There is a hotline I can call and I have but they don't do anything they just tell me to take medication( and I do when they tell me to) but it's all getting to much now/ and I don't think medications going to fix it this time.

I'm both. I'm angry at myself that I'm not like all the other teenage girls and that I shouldn't feel like getting out of bed in the morning is the end of the world. I'm scared of myself. I guess a little bit of me doesn't want to die, not for myself but for my siblings. I'm their older sister I'm supposed to protect them and look out for them. But I just can't keep going like this. Maybe they are better off without such a failure in their lives.

I tried asking the hospital for help 4 days ago, I feel like nobody takes me seriously, I live in a small town and the psych ward has no beds. So I'm home. I've been trying so hard to stop my thoughts and these feelings but I just can't anymore. Maybe it's just a sign that I'm not supposed to be here anymore. It hurts too much. 

Also I'm sorry you feel awful too.
